      • registerIfNew

        public boolean registerIfNew(String name,
                             AsyncHttpClient ahc)
        Description copied from interface: AsyncHttpClientRegistry
        Will register only if an instance with this name doesn't exist and if it does exist will not replace this instance and will return false. Use it in the following way: 
              AsyncHttpClient ahc = AsyncHttpClientFactory.getAsyncHttpClient();
      if(!AsyncHttpClientRegistryImpl.getInstance().registerIfNew(“MyAHC”,ahc)){
          //An instance with this name is already registered so close ahc
          ahc.close();
          //and do necessary cleanup
      }
        Specified by:
        registerIfNew in interface AsyncHttpClientRegistry
        Parameters:
        name - the name of the client instance in the registry
        ahc - the client instance
        Returns:
        true is the client was indeed registered
